dct_description_sm:
The Town of Whitby Find Your Cycling Route Map displays cycling routes and trails that permit bike traffic. 

Routes such as bike lanes, bike routes, multi use pathways, rural paved shoulders and urban paved shoulders are all displayed.

Map used in Find Your Cycling Route app.

Updated August 2020.
